<p>The Punisher is back. He may have no memories, but he has a full clip and a thirst for wrathful vengeance — and his violent search for answers could only be chronicled in a Red Band series! Bullets will fly, blood will flow and the citizens and criminals of New York City alike will once again fear the name THE PUNISHER! From the superstar HELLVERINE creative team of Benjamin Percy and Julius Ohta! COLLECTING: Punisher: Red Band (2025) #1-5</p>
